propositions: Focused editor test test_server_binds_loopback_only exhibits a recurring ~35-second setup phase in Gerrit Verify CI runs despite subsecond/2.44s performance in local targeted runs, indicating a CI-specific bottleneck unrelated to generic worker starvation or Pandoc replay.

CPython ThreadingHTTPServer constructor synchronously calls socket.getfqdn on numeric loopback 127.0.0.1, triggering a ~35-second reverse-DNS lookup timeout on macOS due to resolver configuration, confirmed by nested instrumentation in Gerrit Verify run 31846417650.

A thresholded pytest fixture-setup observer must emit worker id, node id, fixture name, and monotonic elapsed time only for spans above one second, with transparent timing around editor server constructor/bind/getfqdn without changing behavior, to discriminate the DNS mechanism from other hypotheses before implementing a fix.

Instrumentation must remain silent outside CI/REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 opt-in, use only monotonic clock and pytest warnings, add no external dependency, and restore wrapped callables before test bodies, preserving original return values and exception identity.

Organic post-merge observation confirms socket.getfqdn=35.013s as the leading dynamic hypothesis; TCP bind, _no_repo_commits fixture, tmp_path, and worker starvation are ruled out; a separate RED/GREEN fix ticket will eliminate the irrelevant DNS lookup while preserving loopback server semantics.
